label: Format
description: Fill a text template with values from the graph. Write it with `{{name}}` placeholders and declare one input port per placeholder: `Format(user: String, count: Number) { template: "Hi {{user}}, you have {{count}} left" }`. A string fills in as is, anything else as its JSON. A placeholder with no port, or a port with no placeholder, fails the node naming it. Literal braces are doubled: `{{{{json}}}}` renders as `{{json}}` and needs no port.

inputs.name: template
inputs.label: Template
inputs.description: The text, with `{{name}}` where an input port's value goes.

outputs.name: text
outputs.description: The template with every placeholder filled.
